#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
task_transfer="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
task_logs="$task_transfer/cm-oneclick-r14/logs"
mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
cm_exit() {
    task_exit=$?
    python3 - "$task_log.EXIT_STATUS.json" "$task_exit" <<'EXIT_PY'
import json,os,sys
path=sys.argv[1];raw=(json.dumps({'exit_code':int(sys.argv[2])})+'\n').encode()
with open(path+'.tmp','xb') as stream:
    stream.write(raw);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
os.replace(path+'.tmp',path)
EXIT_PY
    printf 'EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n' "$task_exit" "$task_log"
}
trap cm_exit EXIT
printf 'CM R14 문서 이름·역할 연결 보완 시작 LOG=%s\n' "$task_log"
python3 - "$task_transfer" "$@" <<'CM_ONECLICK_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,sys,types,zlib
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!='45bab051df4c72ac69961e681a2cbac0d04bacad188d91a4e3e8efaeea4e147c':raise ValueError('Embedded bundle hash mismatch')
bundle=json.loads(raw);m=types.ModuleType('cm_oneclick')
code=base64.b64decode(bundle['code'])
if hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest()!='8df197ade3b767578ba25cfd3c8bceb02052fccef66199f0015324d8dd2a43f1':raise ValueError('Embedded installer hash mismatch')
exec(compile(code,'genos_cm_oneclick.py','exec'),m.__dict__)
raise SystemExit(m.main(bundle['spec'],sys.argv[1:]))
CM_ONECLICK_PY
